summary: The proof is complete and correct. In each parity class, the heavy construction attains the exact unmatched minimum, while the nonheavy interpolation leaves residual degrees of total 2 beta with each at most beta; the antipodal circle construction realizes those degrees symmetrically with zero diagonal mass. The one-fiber centroid depth bound correctly controls every class maximum and yields the stated HW bounds. The mass, deficit, and paired-volume identities give the constants 1, 3/2, and 3 exactly, and gamma_d at most 1/2 makes p, r, and q admissible in the half-fiber normalization.
